nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: All questions will be based on Subject-Specific Knowledge.
Sequences and Series: Convergence of sequences of real numbers, Comparison, root andratio
nodes.body: tests for convergence of series of real numbers.

nodes.title: Differential Calculus: Limits, continuity and differentiability of functions of one and two
nodes.body: variables. Rolle's Theorem, mean value theorems, Taylor's theorem, indeterminate forms,maxima and minima of functions of one and two variables.

nodes.title: Integral Calculus: Fundamental theorems of integral calculus. Double and triple integrals,
nodes.body: applications of definite integrals, arc lengths, areas and volumes.

nodes.title: Matrices: Rank, inverse of a matrix. Systems of linear equations. Linear transformations,
nodes.body: eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Cayley‐Hamilton theorem, symmetric, skew‐symmetric and orthogonal matrices.

nodes.title: Differential Equations: Ordinary differential equations of the first order of the form y' =
nodes.body: f(x,y). Linear differential equations of the second order with constant coefficients.

nodes.title: Descriptive Statistics and Probability: Measure of Central tendency, Measure of dispersion,
nodes.body: skewness and Kurtosis, Elementary analysis of data. Axiomatic definition of probability and properties, conditional probability, multiplication rule. Theorem of total probability. Bayes’ theorem and independence of events.

nodes.title: Random Variables: Probability mass function, probability density function and cumulative
nodes.body: distribution functions, distribution of a function of a random variable. Mathematical expectation, moments and moment generating function. Chebyshev'sinequality.

nodes.title: Standard Distributions: Binomial, negative binomial, geometric, Poisson, hyper- geometric,
nodes.body: uniform, exponential, gamma, beta and normal distributions. Poisson and normal approximations of a binomial distribution. Chi-square distribution, t-distribution and F- distribution.

nodes.title: Joint Distributions: Joint, marginal and conditional distributions. Distribution of functionsof
nodes.body: random variables. Product moments, correlation, simple linear regression. Independence of

nodes.title: random variables Limit Theorems: Weak law of large numbers. Central limit theorem (i.i.d.
Estimation: Unbiasedness, consistency and efficiency of estimators, method of momentsand
nodes.body: method of maximum likelihood. Sufficiency, factorization theorem. Completeness, Rao‐ Blackwell and Lehmann‐Scheffe theorems, uniformly minimum variance unbiased estimators. Rao‐Cramer inequality. Confidence intervals for the parameters of univariate normal, two independent normal, and one parameter exponential distributions.

nodes.title: Testing of Hypotheses: Basic concepts, applications of Neyman‐Pearson Lemma fortesting
nodes.body: simple and composite hypotheses. Likelihood ratio tests.

nodes.title: Sampling and Designs of Experiments: Simple random sampling, stratified sampling and
nodes.body: Cluster sampling, One-way, two-way analysis of variance. CRD, RBD, LSD and 2² and 2³ factorial experiments.
